rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home structure and contents caused by a burst supply line in the home's plumbing is direct property damage to the insured premises.
claim_summary: Homeowner Sam Patel returned from a work trip to find basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water throughout, causing buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to 1 foot high, and multiple ruined stored boxes. Cause is a burst water supply line in the home's plumbing. Estimated damage exceeds $25,000 and requires urgent on-site assessment and water remediation.

case_facts.incident_description: basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water throughout
case_facts.damage_drywall: drywall soaked up to approximately 1 foot high
case_facts.cause: burst water supply line in policyholder's plumbing

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own residential structure (roof shingles on porch overhang) with no third-party involvement or theft.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang with four shingles blown off (estimated repair cost $400). No water entry or secondary damage. Policyholder's deductible of $2,500 exceeds the estimated damage amount.

case_facts.description: wind damage - four shingles blown off overhang
